items.title: Joe Wilder Part 1 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: He was a tenor player, I think he played tenor. And he was a fellow who didn’t play very well. But he was very persistent.

ctx.x: He was a tenor player, I think he played tenor. And he was a fellow who didn’t play very well. But he was very persistent. He would come up and when all the other guys were up there jamming, guys who were known to be pretty talented, and he would just stand there and sort of look, with his horn hanging, and say, like you know, “when do I play?’ you know or something. And finally somebody’d say, “okay, come on in.” They called him “The Demon” because he would play like ten choruses and compiled they wouldn’t make…
The Basie band, you were with them what, just about a year?
